name: job-interview-meeting-preparation
description: Prepare for a high-stakes meeting by first choosing which one it is: an interview, a peer or stakeholder, an operator, or a board member or other CxO. Researches the company and stakeholder, tailors the conversation to that meeting type, and produces an in-conversation brief and a printable HTML and PDF one-pager. Run a series of meetings inside a Claude Project so each brief builds on the last.
